_doc: Hoards (Expedition.Treasure). A hoard holds an item at itemChancePerTier a site level (at most itemChanceMax), its rarity by hoardTiers (tier 2 uncommon, 3 rare, 4 very rare, 5 legendary; up: the chance of one finer); a hero takes no gift or forge order finer than their level's hoards hold (Content.Ready). slots: what a hero or the town can carry home from one (hoards also hold draughts and siege pieces, "hoardSlots"). pulled: library items never found, with no fitting effect (Conner, 2026-10-23). offFit: a hoard's weight on a piece that doesn't belong in the site's country (enchantments.json found), against affinity for one that does.
